about: lev_4_m1 twiglets: Roman warped into trigger volume 76 (bb_40x40, on_enter 200), which activates the twiglet generators 64, 75 and 78 (l4_tree_dense_a, release_max 10, initial_ic mover_twiglet_tree_a_01 / 02); the swarm releases their 30 twiglets out of the trees (IC movers) over ~5 s, each pulls a bomb out and runs at Roman, slowing on the hills; Roman stands. Traced to frame 1240, before the first bomb (original 1300, remaster 1258): from there each game's Roman is somewhere else (the original's is knocked about by grunts 283 / 284, known below), so the bombs reach him at different times; the explosion chain is checked by engine/playtests/twiglets.json

known.grunt.mind: B6: grunts 284 (64 units off, on the ridge at (242, -2, -11)) and 283 take the warped Roman as their target and fire from frame 58 in the original; the remaster's stay in Roam (grunt sight: agent-aiparity2)
known.roman.health: B6: the original's Roman is shot by grunts 283 / 284 (400 -> 320 by frame 1160)
known.roman.pos: B6: the original's Roman is knocked 16 units about by those hits
known.events.sounds: B17 rest (load-time sounds, random picks, the grunts' fire and Roman's hit sounds of B6)
